en: Black‑and‑white view across a wide river toward a hill crowned by a large medieval castle complex. Below the castle, closer to the water, stand industrial and residential buildings with a tall chimney. A low weir or series of posts crosses the river, and a stone arch bridge is visible in the distance on the right. In the foreground, a small rowboat with two people is on the water. The image has wide white margins like an old photographic postcard. No printed or handwritten text is visible on the image side.
